pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with softened vertices and moderately sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Relative spatial area is high compared to inter-patch spacing.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way and four-way intersections with consistent pixel thickness across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous dark silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder with low-amplitude, high-frequency jaggedness reflecting individual hair tufts.
